note: Grikka Ragtooth of the Ragtooth goblins (data/creatures/goblin_tribes.json, Dave 20 Nov 2026: "this is Grikka Ragtooth please add her to the game"; the Ragtooth are "friendly goblins but nervous"). Kin to Skritch (PROVISIONAL, from her name). Stands by the fire and sends a player to Skritch, the trader. See hob.json for the format. PROVISIONAL lines (GOBLIN-6, docs/design/GOBLIN_CAMP.md).

greeting: Hm. Big-folk. Grikka sees you. Stay there.
You talk soft? Then Grikka talks.
Skritch is Grikka's kin. Trade with Skritch.
idle: Fire needs wood. Snag is lazy.
info: Skritch trades. Grikka watches the fire.
